subject.title: fix(qqbot): render safe exec approval previews

question: Should this PR merge with deterministic renderer, payload artifact, and CI proof plus an explicit maintainer proof override, or must it wait for a redacted QQ Desktop/mobile capture?
rationale: ClawSweeper cannot treat the upstream QQ client-rendering claim as live-proven from unit tests and payload artifacts, but a maintainer may intentionally own that remaining proof gap.

options.title: Accept Proof Override
options.body: A maintainer explicitly records that the deterministic payload proof is enough and owns the QQ Desktop rendering assumption before merge.

options.title: Require QQ Capture
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until someone with QQ Desktop/mobile access attaches a redacted after-fix screenshot or recording.

options.title: Pause The Fix
options.body: Leave the linked issue open and defer the renderer change if maintainers do not want to merge without live client proof.

recommendation.title: Accept Proof Override
recommendation.body: A maintainer explicitly records that the deterministic payload proof is enough and owns the QQ Desktop rendering assumption before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned, posted the exact-head verification, and already framed the remaining decision as capture versus proof override.
